title: WebCMS KosDB Integration
instructions: Integrate KosDB (LevelDB socket server) as a database backend option for WebCMS. Create a KosDB adapter that allows WebCMS to use KosDB instead of PostgreSQL/MySQL. Features: connection pooling, SQL command translation, authentication integration, replication support, and admin tools.

1783295106.287488.instruction: Create webcms/database/kosdb_client.py - A Python client for KosDB socket server with connection pooling, automatic reconnection, and query methods. Implement methods: connect(), execute(), query(), close(). Support async operations with threading.

1783295106.325983.instruction: Create webcms/database/kosdb_dialect.py - SQLAlchemy dialect adapter for KosDB. Implement KosDBDialect class with compiler for CREATE, INSERT, SELECT, UPDATE, DELETE. Map SQLAlchemy types to KosDB types. Handle transactions and connection management.

1783295106.3261936.instruction: Create webcms/auth/kosdb_auth.py - Bridge WebCMS auth with KosDB user system. Sync WebCMS users to KosDB, authenticate against KosDB, map KosDB privileges to WebCMS roles. Support both systems running independently or unified.

1783295106.3263373.instruction: Create webcms/database/kosdb_replication.py - Integration with KosDB replication features. Monitor replication status, handle failover, configure master-slave and master-master setups. WebCMS admin panel integration for replication management.

1783295106.3264654.instruction: Create webcms/admin/kosdb_admin.py - Admin panel extensions for KosDB management. Features: database browser, query executor, user management, privilege editor, replication status dashboard, binlog viewer. REST API endpoints for KosDB operations.

1783295106.3265977.instruction: Update WebCMS configuration to support KosDB backend. Create migration tools: PostgreSQL/MySQL to KosDB exporter, KosDB backup/restore, data validation. Update docker-compose with KosDB service. Document KosDB setup and integration.
